text: I can sort a list of requirements into functional, non-functional (with numbers) and invariants, and write each invariant on its own line.
I can ask questions on users, scale, read/write mix, latency, consistency, durability and regions, and say how each answer changes the design.
I turn every numeric answer into requests per second or storage before leaving the Requirements step.
I state assumptions aloud with a reason, label them on the board, and never assume away the hard part.
I write an out-of-scope list that keeps the core loop and the hard requirement, with a reason for each cut and an offer to return.
